remaining_songs = songs[2:]  # skip first two already added
for title, artist in remaining_songs:
    # Search for the song
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_login['access_token'])
    # Find exact match: title matches and artist(s) match
    match = None
    for song in results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check artist match
            song_artists = [a['name'] for a in song['artists']]
            # Artist string may have multiple names separated by comma
            expected_artists = [a.strip() for a in artist.split(',')]
            if all(any(exp.lower() == sa.lower() for sa in song_artists) for exp in expected_artists):
                match = song
                break
    if match:
        add_resp = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=654, song_id=match['song_id'], access_token=spotify_login['access_token'])
        print(f"Added: {title} by {artist} -> {add_resp}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title} by {artist}")
